In a Rotom endgame, cap Sucker attempts at two — once the WoW/Protect stall pattern appears, switch to Kowtow Cleave, which cannot fail into Protect or status.
reflections.notebook: Sim quirks: Water and Electric are NEUTRAL vs Steel here; Rotom TBolt hits KG 1x (30-52%); Hydro Pump KOs KG from ~32%. Speeds: KG Sucker (+1) always outprioritizes Rotom. KG vs Rotom 1v1 is lost once KG is burned — burned BlackGlasses Sucker (fallen2) does ~23% to Bold Rotom and Leftovers outpaces it; Sucker also fails into WoW/Protect. Opponent Rotom piloting: attacks aggressively until Sucker is obvious, then WoW -> Protect -> attack; counter by switching to Kowtow after two failed Suckers. Opponent runs a dedicated anti-KG core: Body Press Mudsdale (4x SE, ignores Intimidate/burn, Stamina +1 Def per physical hit), WoW Rotom, Armor Tail Farigiraf (blocks all priority) — KG cannot be the solo closer vs this core; keep a second attacker alive. Gholdengo blanks Whimsicott/Gengar (Steel resists Fairy, immune to Poison; Good as Gold blocks Taunt/Encore) — that pair traded 2-for-1 and should not face it. Opponent left Azumarill/Corviknight home in the decider, favoring the KG-answer core; expect the same bring in future. Series lost 1-2.

reflections.summary: Our Rotom-Wash was the decisive factor: it burned Kingambit early, reducing its offensive pressure, then KO'd Gyarados with Thunderbolt, and outlasted the burned Kingambit in a 1v1. Farigiraf fell to a critical hit and Kingambit's Kowtow Cleave, but Mudsdale's Stamina and Protect bought time. The plan to preserve Rotom as wincon succeeded.
reflections.adjustment: Consider leading with Rotom and Mudsdale to apply immediate pressure and prevent Gyarados from freely attacking. Prioritize burning Kingambit earlier, and use Mudsdale's Rock Slide to fish for flinches against Gyarados or Kingambit. Also, consider setting Trick Room earlier to support slower teammates like Farigiraf and Mudsdale.
